name: TEMPLATE — copy to platform/profiles/<your-service>.json and edit
description: Profiles starting with '_' are ignored by the launcher. Fields: target_group (gateway|compute|legacy — legacy/compute refuse docker per Law 1/3), services{} (image, host_port=null for internal-only, container_port, mem_limit_mb, cpus, env_names = secret names pulled from .env at deploy time — NEVER literal values, env_static for non-secrets, volumes {name: container_path}, health_path, restart, depends_on), exposure (mesh|tunnel|loopback), tunnel_hostname (CF Access-gated when exposure=tunnel), dns_gui_name (AdGuard *.gui rewrite), backup_paths (fleet_backup.sh targets), tags.
